footer.ai: AI-assisted tool: it relays scholars' gradings from their sources, issues no verdict of its own, and is no substitute for asking scholars.
footer.demo: Texts, numbers and gradings are relayed from the approved sources and should be reviewed before relying on them.

banner.text: This is an AI-assisted tool. It relays hadith scholars' gradings from their sources, never issues its own verdict, and is no substitute for asking scholars. Your input is not stored on our servers; when the AI explanation is enabled, the text is sent to the language-model provider for wording only.

home.sub: Paste a hadith, a report or a quote in any language to see its source, the scholars' grading and the accuracy of its translation.
home.placeholder: Paste the text here… a hadith, a report, a verse, or a saying attributed to a scholar
home.dropHelp: PNG or JPG up to 10 MB · we extract the text (OCR) then verify it
home.ocrDone: Full extracted text (review and edit before verifying; the saying is separated from the chain of narrators automatically)
home.urlHelp: Works with public articles, sunnah.com pages and X posts only. Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and TikTok do not expose their content; paste the text or a screenshot instead.
home.does: We search the text in the approved sources and show its source, grade and translation accuracy.
home.doesnt: We relay hadith scholars' gradings from their sources and never issue an automated verdict
home.ex2: من عرف نفسه فقد عرف ربه
home.ex3: None of you is a Muslim until…

result.closestNote: The grading below applies to the closest text, not to your text.
result.noRuling: No recorded ruling for this text in our data.
result.termsSub: Kept as terms and explained, never translated literally
result.candSub: Up to 5 results, ranked by match
result.reviewSent: Request sent. A specialist will review it within 48 hours.
result.note: We relay hadith scholars’ gradings from their sources. We never issue automated verdicts.
result.loadingSub: Matching your text against the approved sources. This usually takes under 10 seconds.
result.absTitle: No reliable reference for this text
result.absBody: We searched every approved source and found no text that matches closely enough. We give no verdict and attribute the text to no source.
absList: Request a human review from our specialists.
Don’t share it as a saying of the Prophet ﷺ until it is verified.
The nearby results are different texts, shown for comparison only.
result.refTitle: This is a personal matter that needs a fatwa
result.refBody: Your input is a question about a ruling for your own situation, not a text to verify. The tool does not issue fatwas or verdicts, so we refer you to scholars.
refList: Ask a recognised fatwa body or a scholar you trust.
Describe your situation fully; rulings depend on the details.
If you have a hadith or verse to verify, paste that text on its own.
result.aiSub: Automatically worded from the facts above; the grading and source come from the original record, not from the model.
result.errBody: Verification did not complete and no result was issued. Your text is kept; try again in a moment.
result.errOcr: Could not extract text from the image
result.errUrl: Could not read the link — paste the text directly
result.notFound: No report with this id in this session.
result.asRecorded: Wording as recorded in the rulings source
result.errUrlBody: We could not read the page (it may be blocked, require login, or contain no text). No result was issued; copy the text and paste it in the text tab.
result.aiFailed: Could not generate the explanation now; try again later.
result.aiExtendedNote: Automatically summarised from the Dorar.net explanation or tafsir text only; review before relying on it.
result.segmentsSub: Extracted from the text with AI help; each segment is verified separately against the sources. The ruling comes from the source, not the model.
result.dorarSub: Fetched from the Dorar.net Hadith Encyclopedia (the approved reference) for the matched hadith, shown verbatim.
result.aiNoSource: Dorar.net has no explanation for this text, so no extended explanation is shown (we never generate one outside the approved sources).
result.mtBody: The text is in a language other than Arabic or English, so it was machine-translated to English only to search the sources. The ruling and source below come from the original record; this translation is not assessed.
result.pdfFooter: Generated by Tahaqqaq (tahaqqaq.pages.dev) on {date}. The tool relays the scholars' rulings from approved sources, issues no ruling of its own, and is no substitute for asking qualified scholars.

verified.label: Confirmed by source
verified.desc: The text was found in an approved source with matching wording.

partial.label: Partially confirmed – variant wording
partial.desc: Found in an approved source, with some words differing from the narration.

uncertain.label: Unconfirmed
uncertain.desc: Not found in this wording. A related text exists and needs review.

abstain.label: No reference – verdict withheld
abstain.desc: This text was not found in any approved source, so no verdict is given.

referral.label: Personal matter – referred for a fatwa
referral.desc: The input is a personal question about a ruling; the tool does not issue fatwas and refers you to scholars.

unreliable.label: Found, graded: {grade}
unreliable.desc: The text exists in the rulings sources and the scholars' recorded ruling is relayed below verbatim. Do not share it as a saying of the Prophet ﷺ.

sources.title: Sources & methodology
sources.intro: We rely on specific, published hadith and Qur'an sources. This page explains what we use, how we reach a result, and where the tool stops.
sources.approvedSub: No source outside this list is used
sources.unreliableWhen: Best match 75% or more with a text whose recorded ruling is fabricated, weak or baseless.
sources.unreliableShow: The verbatim ruling and its source, the wording as recorded, and a warning not to attribute it.

recent.title: Recent checks
recent.sub: This session only, kept in your browser and deleted when you close it. No accounts, no sign-in.
recent.emptyHelp: Every result you verify will appear here until you close the browser.
